title: Vibration window
description: One fixed-rate accelerometer sample window, published by the ESP32 firmware (main/app_main.c, build_window_json) and consumed by the Pi ingest service (backend/ingest.py, validate_payload). Published to topic sensors/<device_id>/vibration/raw.

sample_rate_hz.description: Sampling rate in Hz, fixed at build time (SAMPLE_RATE_HZ).

ax.description: X-axis acceleration samples, in window order.

ay.description: Y-axis acceleration samples, in window order.

az.description: Z-axis acceleration samples, in window order.

$comment: ax/ay/az must all be the same length (one window's worth of samples per axis) -- JSON Schema can't express a cross-field length constraint like this on its own, so ingest.py's validate_payload() checks it separately at runtime.
